purpose: Local web control center for Pritha and child agents: agents overview, Voice Control, NeuralDeep-only Task Chat, settings-lite and read-only developer diagnostics.

runtime.external_mode: Use production build/start for Tailscale or other non-local browser access. Next dev is local-only because the dev client can fail to hydrate behind HTTPS proxying.

browser_must_not_receive: private NeuralDeep session or topic ids
privacy_boundary.tracked_policy: Do not commit real Tailscale URLs, tailnet names, device hostnames or local secrets.
